In detail

Tor di Quinto is a mixed area along the Tiber combining a military zone/barracks, equestrian facilities, and residential streets near Ponte Milvio. It carries historical weight in Rome's safety debates: the November 2007 murder of Giovanna Reggiani near a dark underpass here triggered a national security emergency - a now-dated but well-known episode. More recently, residents near Stazione Vigna Clara/Fleming have complained about unlit, unguarded stretches, and the area featured in 2025-2026 joint police operations that produced multiple arrests for property crime. Day is calm around the equestrian and military facilities; night warrants some caution, especially in poorly lit stretches.
